Magnetic loop: independent 2D reference and refinement Compare genuine 2D magnetic-loop transport with final conserved fields from independent Athena++, qualified in space and time. Assumptions, units and boundaries Periodic[-1,1]x[-.5,.5],rho=p1,Az=.001max(.3-r,0),T1,(Nx,Ny)=(16,8),(32,16),(64,32). Use unchanged official-generator v=(2,1,2), explicitly distinct from old vz0 inputs. Editorial clarification Educational fixed inputs only. Count HLLD-to-HLLE fallbacks and face reconstruction positivity scaling; no cell floor/clipping/retry. Finite-grid references are not exact solutions; no universal stability, positivity or order guarantee. Independent comparisons are final-only. Intermediate Athena outputs occur just after requested quarter times and are not matched frames. Athena native-face divergence is not exported/measured. Density contrast diagnoses compression, not a mathematical proof of shock formation. Adopted numerical method Full-eight-state HLLD fluxes, MC-MUSCL reconstruction and fixed-step Heun. Shared face fluxes and CT-contact corner EMFs update native face B; cell B is adjacent-face averaged.
